glare_model_scope: 60 provisional eye positions (30 courtyard, 30 foyer), seated 1.2m and standing 1.6m, eight horizontal gaze directions each. All scheduled sources summed at the SAME observer and heading. Centre sheer raised, glazing transmission assumed 0.7 per pane. Foliage is not credited as shielding. Direct source-point exposure only; no reflections, actual emitting-aperture visibility/luminance, adaptation, or discomfort certification. An unmodelled or unbearable glare condition cannot pass installation acceptance.
